mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ct_upload(userId, objectKey, originalName, contentType, fileSize, category) VALUES(#{userId}, #{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{category})
mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM ct_upload u JOIN ct_board_attachment a ON a.uploadId = u.uploadId WHERE a.boardId = #{boardId} ORDER BY u.uploadId
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ct_board_attachment WHERE boardId = #{boardId} AND uploadId = #{uploadId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ct_s3_deletion(objectKey) SELECT objectKey FROM ct_upload u WHERE u.uploadId = #{uploadId} AND u.category = 'attachment' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ct_board_attachment a WHERE a.uploadId = u.uploadId)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ct_upload WHERE uploadId = #{uploadId} AND category = 'attachment' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ct_board_attachment a WHERE a.uploadId = ct_upload.uploadId)
